title: Establish Sign Convention
text: Taking rightward as positive means: Trolley A velocity = +6 m/s, Trolley B velocity = -3 m/s (leftward is negative).

title: Calculate Each Momentum
text: Momentum of A: $$p_A = m_A v_A = 4 \times 6 = 24$$ kg.m/s. Momentum of B: $$p_B = m_B v_B = 2 \times (-3) = -6$$ kg.m/s.

title: Find Total Momentum
text: Total momentum = $$p_A + p_B = 24 + (-6) = 18$$ kg.m/s (positive means rightward).
